description: This file defines data structures, templates, and macros for network traffic annotation in Chromium, including hash computation, annotation tags, partial annotations, and related utilities.

classes.name: NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Represents a network traffic annotation with a unique hash code.

classes.name: PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Represents a partial network traffic annotation with optional completing ID.

classes.name: MutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Mutable version of NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag for construction and modification.

classes.name: MutablePartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: Mutable version of PartialNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag for construction and modification.

methods.name: recursive_hash
methods.description: Computes a compile-time hash of a string recursively.

methods.name: DefineNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Defines a network traffic annotation tag from a unique ID and proto.

methods.name: DefinePartialNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Defines a partial network traffic annotation with optional completing ID.

methods.name: CompleteNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Completes a partial annotation into a full annotation.

methods.name: BranchedCompleteNetworkTrafficAnnotation
methods.description: Completes a partial annotation into a branched annotation with a group ID.

methods.name: CreateMutableNetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
methods.description: Creates a mutable network traffic annotation tag.
